title: Left-acyclic objects in short exact sequences
statement: Let $\mathcal A,\mathcal B$ be abelian categories [def-sp-abelian], where $\mathcal A$ has enough projectives: every object is a quotient of an object $P$ such that every map $P\to Y$ lifts across every epimorphism $X\to Y$. Let $V:\mathcal A\to\mathcal B$ be additive and right exact (preserving cokernels and finite direct sums). Write $Q$ for localization of the homotopy category of integer cochain complexes at quasi-isomorphisms [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Assume the total left derived functor $LV:D(\mathcal A)\to D(\mathcal B)$ is defined at every object in the essentially-constant denominator-diagram sense of Situation 05S8 and Definition 05S9 [def-pur-saturated-triangulated-localization], with its canonical natural comparison $\varepsilon_C:LV(QC)\to Q(V(C))$. Call $M\in\mathcal A$ left $V$-acyclic if $\varepsilon_{M[0]}:LV(Q(M[0]))\to Q(V(M)[0])$ is an isomorphism, where $M[0]$ is the complex concentrated in degree zero. For every short exact sequence $0\to M'\xrightarrow{i}M\xrightarrow{p}M''\to0$ in $\mathcal A$: (1) if $M'$ and $M''$ are left $V$-acyclic, then $M$ is left $V$-acyclic and $0\to V(M')\xrightarrow{V(i)}V(M)\xrightarrow{V(p)}V(M'')\to0$ is short exact; (2) if $M$ and $M''$ are left $V$-acyclic, then $M'$ is left $V$-acyclic and that same image sequence is short exact.

source.place: Dual of Tag 015D, lemma-F-acyclic-ses, clauses (1) and (2). The total comparison is interpreted as in Tags 05S8 and 05S9; Tag 015C, lemma-F-acyclic, identifies object acyclicity with the degree-zero comparison and higher vanishing.

proof.text: Put $T^q(N)=H^q(LV(Q(N[0])))$. By [lem-trf-total-left-derived-object-ses-triangle], the given short exact sequence gives a distinguished triangle with first two arrows $LV(Q(i[0]))$ and $LV(Q(p[0]))$. Its assumptions, including everywhere-definedness, are precisely those of the item.

source.place: Tag 015D (lemma-F-acyclic-ses), proof, dualized: distinguished triangle construction and exactness of total left derivation (old Steps 2--3); supporting lemma-additive-exact-homotopy-category, lemma-acyclic, lemma-derived-canonical-delta-functor and proposition-derived-functor.

proof.text: Apply [lem-trf-left-derived-ses-cohomology-normalization] to this triangle. For every integer $q$ we obtain the exact consecutive terms $T^{q-1}(M\prime\prime)\to T^q(M\prime)\to T^q(M)\to T^q(M\prime\prime)\to T^{q+1}(M\prime)$ and the exact tail $T^{-1}(M\prime\prime)\to V(M\prime)\xrightarrow{V(i)}V(M)\xrightarrow{V(p)}V(M\prime\prime)\to0$. The normalization uses the actual counit and its naturality, so these are the specified image arrows.

source.place: Tag 015D (lemma-F-acyclic-ses), proof, dualized: cohomology sequence, positive-degree vanishing and identification of the degree-zero arrows (old Steps 1 and 4); supporting lemma-cohomology-homological, lemma-negative-vanishing, lemma-left-exact-higher-derived and lemma-irrelevant.

proof.text: Put $T^q(A)=H^q(LV(Q(A[0])))$. By [lem-trf-left-derived-object-cohomology], $T^q(A)=0$ for $q>0$ and the actual counit gives natural isomorphisms $c_A:T^0(A)\xrightarrow{\sim}V(A)$. Also $A$ is left $V$-acyclic exactly when $T^q(A)=0$ for all $q<0$. Its hypotheses hold by the assumptions above, including pointwise definedness on unbounded complexes. We will use integer cohomological indices throughout, so the usual higher left derived functors occur in negative degrees.

source.place: Duals of Tags 05TC, 05TD and 015C, using Tag 05T5 (3)-(4).

proof.text: For clause (1), suppose $M'$ and $M''$ are left $V$-acyclic. Step 3 makes $T^q(M')=T^q(M'')=0$ for every $q<0$. Exactness of $T^q(M')\to T^q(M)\to T^q(M'')$ from Step 2 forces $T^q(M)=0$: its identity factors through the zero object, since both the image and the kernel at this term are zero. By [lem-trf-left-derived-object-cohomology], $M$ is left $V$-acyclic. In addition $T^{-1}(M'')=0$, so the tail in Step 2 starts with $0\to V(M')$ and ends with $V(M'')\to0$. This is exactly the asserted short exact image sequence.

For clause (2), suppose $M$ and $M''$ are left $V$-acyclic. For every $q<0$, the sequence in Step 2 contains $T^{q-1}(M'')\to T^q(M')\to T^q(M)$ with both outside objects zero, since $q-1<0$ and $q<0$. Exactness forces $T^q(M')=0$, hence [lem-trf-left-derived-object-cohomology] shows that $M'$ is left $V$-acyclic. Again $T^{-1}(M'')=0$, so the same degree-zero tail is $0\to V(M')\xrightarrow{V(i)}V(M)\xrightarrow{V(p)}V(M'')\to0$. This proves every assertion in clause (2).
